title: Reported arm64 Compiler Miscompiles Allegedly Induce Vulnerabilities in curl
summary: According to reports from Daniel Stenberg, two arm64-specific compiler miscompiles have allegedly introduced security vulnerabilities into the curl utility. These unverified compiler-induced issues specifically affect systems running the arm64 architecture. Developers and system administrators deploying curl on arm64 hardware should monitor for official patches or compiler updates.

sections.title: Background
sections.content: Daniel Stenberg serves as the lead maintainer of curl, a widely deployed command-line tool and library used for transferring data with URLs across numerous operating systems and architectures.

sections.title: Impact
sections.content: Organizations running curl on arm64 architectures face potential security vulnerabilities stemming from compiler miscompiles, requiring updates once fixes are released.

reliability.label: unverified
reasons: claim reported: Stated by Daniel Stenberg via a social media post linking to a discussion about arm64-specific miscompiles affecting curl.
